definitions.explanation: A period of temporary economic decline.

examples.japanese: {不況|ふきょう}で{会社|かいしゃ}が{倒産|とうさん}した。
examples.english: The company went bankrupt due to the recession.

examples.japanese: {不況|ふきょう}から{脱出|だっしゅつ}する。
{長引|ながび}く{不況|ふきょう}に{苦|くる}しむ。
{不況|ふきょう}{対策|たいさく}として{減税|げんぜい}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Tax cuts were implemented as a recession countermeasure.

examples.japanese: {世界的|せかいてき}な{不況|ふきょう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{人員|じんいん}{削減|さくげん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Due to the global recession, many companies carried out staff reductions.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{不|ふ} (not) + {況|きょう} (situation/condition) = bad economic situation

ANTONYM:
{好況|こうきょう}: prosperity, economic boom

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {不況|ふきょう}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into recession
- {不況|ふきょう}{対策|たいさく}: recession countermeasures
- {大|だい}{不況|ふきょう}: great recession
- {不況|ふきょう}から{脱|だっ}する: to emerge from recession
- {長引|ながび}く{不況|ふきょう}: prolonged recession

RELATED ECONOMIC TERMS:
- {景気|けいき}: economic conditions
- {恐慌|きょうこう}: economic panic/depression (more severe)
